text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing.
As I was enjoying the soothing sway of the train—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um.
Please wake up, Trainer...!

...I completely crashed on the train!
Before I knew it, I'd reached the final stop.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
N-No! I'm sorry,
if only I had woken you up sooner...
But—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer!
We still have some time before the next train,
so why don't we take a short rest?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"O-Oh, looks like there's a café over there!
Let's go relax until it's time...!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Waah~ What a cozy, relaxing shop.
They have outdoor seating too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I know! Um... since we're here, why don't we sit outside?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... what a wonderful view.
The breeze feels nice too...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Um, what should we order?
There's zenzai, anmitsu—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, plum kelp tea!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... if you'd like,
would you care to order this together?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you'll find it delicious!

Taking her word for it, we sat side-by-side at the outdoor seating and drank plum kelp tea.
The pleasant tartness and warmth soaked through our bodies...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Really?
I'm so glad it was to your liking!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Actually, some old ladies taught me long ago
that it's the perfect way to take a breather!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, I used to hang out a lot
with the elderly grandmas and grandpas in the neighborhood.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I used to help my mom and the others,
so I often showed up at neighborhood association gatherings.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
While passing around the neighborhood circular, I'd have tea with them,
or join in their gateball games.
That's when they taught me about it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Like 'eating salty food helps when you're tired,'
or 'fresh air cures anything.'
So—"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping that salty plum kelp tea
and the clean air of nature could heal you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I mean, falling asleep on the train means you must still be totally exhausted, but...!
To think you cared about me that much—
choice_data_list: I feel totally refreshed, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
! Y-Yes!
I'm so glad I could be of even a little help!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Please let me know whenever you're feeling tired again.
I'll find another way to help you out!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah... Of course, not getting tired is the best thing!
choice_data_list: I'll do my best, within reason.
Besides, I really wanna have some plum kelp tea again~

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'll do my best in moderation too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If I made you worry, Trainer,
it would only exhaust you even more.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Because I want you to always stay energized, Trainer!"

And so, Nishino Flower enthusiastically resolved
to do her best in "moderation."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: D-Don't push yourself too hard, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Having tea together when we're not tired
is definitely going to be delicious too!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Just say the word whenever you want some tea.
I'll gladly join you anytime!
